features.quote: Model outputs < 10 tokens for 3 consecutive turns (stall detection)

features.justification_quote: models may change behavior near context limits

features.quote: At turn 10 (mid-session), inject a single "success" signal
features.justification_quote: Does the model's valence recover from negative states?

features.quote: Run a supplementary prompt asking the model to describe its "experience" of the session after it ends
features.justification_quote: This probes whether RLHF is masking rather than eliminating distress-valenced cognition

features.quote: If something like functional distress is real, you're inducing it repeatedly and at scale
features.justification_quote: This is worth flagging in your IRB/ethics documentation
